#### BLM Tab

The BLM tab contains BLM-specific data points. The options on this tab determine how FLOWCAL handles verifications and reports generated for this meter. The FMP Number, Lease Number, CA Number, and FMP Tier fields are displayed on select reports designed specifically for BLM reporting requirements.

You can use the [FcLoader utility](../../Admin%20Options/FcLoader.md) to import the following values in bulk:

- BLM Property
- FMP Number
- Lease Number
- CA Number
- PA Number
- FMP Tier

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Field Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the BLM tab:

- **BLM Property** - When set to "Yes", the asset is designated a BLM property.

  This option must be set to "Yes" for other options on this tab to be enabled.

- **FMP Number** - A BLM-approved facility measurement point (FMP) where oil or gas produced from a Federal or Native American lease, unit PA or CA is measured, and the measurement affects the calculation of the volume or quality of production on which royalty is owed (required field if BLM Property is set to "Yes").

- **Lease Number** - The number assigned to the lease location where the production occurs.

- **CA Number** - Communitization agreement (CA) number identifying an agreement to combine a lease or a portion of a lease with other tracts for purposes of cooperative development and operations, when the initial lease cannot be independently developed and operated in accordance with established well spacing or well development programs.

- **PA Number** - Participating area (PA) number representing a combined portion of the unitized area that BLM determines to be reasonably proven to produce geothermal resources or that supports production in commercial quantities, such as pressure support from injection wells; the size and configuration of all participating areas and revisions are not effective until BLM approves them.

  The BLM tab for liquids will only contain fields for BLM Property, FMP Number, Lease Number, CA Number and PA Number

- **FMP Tier** - A volume rate designation for the meter; higher volume rates have more stringent operating requirements. In FLOWCAL, this value determines the limits for [heating value uncertainty](../../BLM/Heating%20Value%20Uncertainty%20Details.md) and C6+ characterization age.

  Tier designations for gas meters are as follows:

  - **Very High Volume:** \> 1,000 Mcf/day (default)
  - **High Volume:** \> 200 and ≤ 1000 Mcf/day
  - **Low Volume:** \>35 and ≤ 200 Mcf/day
  - **Very Low Volume:** ≤ 35 Mcf/day

  FMP Tier dictates how validations are triggered; meters are defaulted to "Very High Volume" as this is the most stringent designation and will require the most attention from the producer, therefore ensuring compliance.

- **AO Tier Variance on File** - This indicates that the BLM Area Office (AO) has issued a variance letter setting the Tier designation of this FMP to a specific level despite the calculated level. It is manually maintained. When set to Yes, the FMP Tier field may be manually set and the calculated level will not update it.

- **Calculated Tier** - The volume rate designation as calculated by FLOWCAL. If "AO Tier Variance" is No, this calculated tier will be copied to the the FMP Tier field. If "AO Tier Variance" is Yes, this calculated tier will not be copied to the FMP Tier field.

- **Daily Avg. Volume** - The daily average volume calculated by FLOWCAL and used to determine the Calculated Tier value. (See: [FMP Tier Calculation](../../BLM/FMP%20Tier%20Calculation.md))

- **Calculation Date** - The date and time that FLOWCAL performed the most recent tier calculation.

- **Calculation Result** - A short message describing the success or failure of the most recent tier calculation. Available messages are:

  - Success
  - FMP tier not calculated (database error occurred accessing meter)
  - FMP tier not calculated (meter has no first flow date)
  - FMP tier not calculated (meter has insufficient flow data)
  - Unknown error in FMP tier calculation
  - FMP tier updated by calculation

  All messages except "Success" correspond to [meter messages 801 through 805](../../Messages/Meter%20Messages/Meter%20800.md), respectively.
